question: Is there a club or group for transfer students or commuters? I don't live on campus and kind of want to meet people

body.answer:
Yes. **Transfer Connection** is an Office Sponsored Organization for transfer students. It shares transfer-related updates, events and activities; visit https://www.ramapo.edu/studentsuccess/transfer-connection/ or follow @rcnjtransfers: https://www.instagram.com/rcnjtransfers/. To ask about its resources, email Meghan Gregory at mgregory@ramapo.edu. The Transfer Center & Veterans Lounge is in E211. [3][14][15]

For commuters, **Commuter Affairs** is a department committed to connecting commuter students socially and academically. Its page is https://www.ramapo.edu/csi/commuter-affairs/. [6]

Ways to meet people: connect with other commuters at Commuter Affairs events; hang out at J.Lee’s for games, programs and free popcorn; join clubs that interest you; and attend CPB/Commuter Affairs events. Commuter Affairs says it offers at least 4 events a month, with sign-ups on its Archway page during Fall and Spring semesters. [7][8][9][13] The monthly Commuter Connections newsletter also shares events and updates. [12]

For help getting involved, contact the Center for Student Involvement: csi@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7593, SC-202. [7][8][9]
